title: A constructive approach to generalized principal connections
summary: We address the recently introduced notions of generalized principal bundle and generalized principal connection by keeping track of global geometric properties through local coordinate transformation laws. This approach leads us to introduce generalized principal bundle coordinates and to find their transformation laws.
